title: Concept: CSRF protection downgraded to a null session in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, Rails is configured to null the session on a CSRF failure. The request continues with an empty session, which turns a rejected forgery into an anonymous request that may still hit an action that does not need login but does change shared state. The setting is often copied to stop 422 responses in an API controller and then applies to siblings through inheritance.
applicability: ruby Rails controllers that mix HTML and API routes.
risk: Cross-site state change without a token; MEDIUM severity.
